'''2001 Chewbacca Con Death Star II Closed Environment (29 July)''' was a Star Wars CCG closed environment tournament held in Boxborough, Massachusetts on 29 July 2001. [[Michael Hawley]] won it. It is known from Michael Hawley's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2758">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-01-father-william-and-endor-closed-7-29-01d2758/ father-william-and-endor-closed-7-29-01], DeckTech (Michael "rayc" Hawley, 1 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-01-father-william-and-endor-closed-7-29-01d2758/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[2001 Chewbacca Con]].

* '''Date:''' 29 July 2001
* '''Site:''' Boxborough, Massachusetts
* '''Format:''' [[Death Star II Closed Environment]]
* '''Players:''' 4
* '''Winner:''' [[Michael Hawley]]
